classification: audit-only, never a Grid/search observation or calibrated replacement
order_reason: Reverse-order crossover balances linear position drift; central O3 adjacency and only two rounds remain limitations. Each group gets a new warmup.
rules: Compare overlapping whole-operation intervals, not core time against host total time.
Per-sample MONOTONIC/RAW intervals surround Evaluator including lookups/resource collection; they are not RAW core times.
Host QPC/Stopwatch surrounds the complete WSL operation including launch and output; retain all endpoint readings.
CLOCK_MONOTONIC core timer, C loops/input/tolerance and configuration measurement interface are unchanged.
Formal JSON gate before setup and each group; recording during execution does not certify a stationary environment.
Any failed warmup/measurement invalidates the group. Retain partial/failed records; no successful-subset score or cache repetitions.
Clock flags are audit findings, not automatic retroactive filtering or single-ratio calibration.
Robust ranking requires identical order in both rounds, all adjacent gaps >= 2%, drift <= 2%, clock checks pass and no runtime resource warning; otherwise only report observed ranks.
No full P3 restart in this task. A future clock/measurement change requires a new protocol, content/session and matching fresh Grid.
